pr_title: executor: fix wrong key range of index scan when filter is comparing year column with NULL
pr_body:
Signed-off-by: guo-shaoge <shaoge1994@163.com>

<!-- Thank you for contributing to TiDB!

PR Title Format:
1. pkg [, pkg2, pkg3]: what's changed
2. *: what's changed

-->

### What problem does this PR solve?

Issue Number: close #23038 <!-- REMOVE this line if no issue to close -->

Problem Summary: use following case:

    use test;
    drop table if exists gjttbl;
    CREATE TABLE `gjttbl` (
        `gjtc1` year(4) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'DATE AND TIME',
        `gjtc2` varchar(20) DEFAULT NULL,
        KEY (`gjtc1`)
        );
    insert into gjttbl values(1, "1");
    insert into gjttbl values(1, "2");
    select  t1.gjtc1, t2.gjtc1  from gjttbl as t1 inner join gjttbl as t2 on t1.gjtc1 = t2.gjtc1 where t1.gjtc1 != NULL;

Output should be empty, but TiDB give result.
### What is changed and how it works?

What's Changed: change datum.go:convertToMysqlYear(), when arg is NULL, this function accidentally set result tobe zero year.

How it Works: go:convertToMysqlYear() is called by ranger.(*builder).buildFormBinOp(), which will build key range. So if go:convertToMysqlYear() change NULL to zero, the key range for index scan is wrong.

### Related changes

- Need to cherry-pick to the release branch

### Check List <!--REMOVE the items that are not applicable-->

Tests <!-- At least one of them must be included. -->


- Integration test: tidb_test.go:TestYear()


Side effects: no

### Release note <!-- bugfixes or new feature need a release note -->

- fix wrong key range of index scan when filter is comparing year column with NULL

issue_context.title: wrong result of "left join where year != null"
issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks!

### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required)

<!-- a step by step guide for reproducing the bug. -->
```
use test;
drop table if exists t;
CREATE TABLE `t` (
  `COL1` year(4) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'DATE AND TIME',
  `COL2` varchar(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  KEY `UK_COL1` (`COL1`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin;
insert into t values(1, "1");
insert into t values(1, "2");
select *  from t as t1 left join t as t2 on t1.col1 = t2.col1 where t1.col1 != NULL;
select count(*) from t as t1 left join t as t2 on t1.col1 = t2.col1 where t1.col1 != NULL;
select t1.col1, t2.col2 from t as t1 left join t as t2 on t1.col1 = t2.col1 where t1.col1 != NULL;
```

### 2. What did you expect to see? (Required)
mysql 8.0.23
```
mysql> select *  from t as t1 left join t as t2 on t1.col1 = t2.col1 where t1.col1 != NULL;
Empty set (0.04 sec)

mysql> select count(*) from t as t1 left join t as t2 on t1.col1 = t2.col1 where t1.col1 != NULL;
+----------+
| count(*) |
+----------+
|        0 |
+----------+
1 row in set (0.04 sec)

mysql> select t1.col1, t2.col2 from t as t1 left join t as t2 on t1.col1 = t2.col1 where t1.col1 != NULL;
Empty set (0.04 sec)
```
### 3. What did you see instead (Required)
master
```
mysql> select *  from t as t1 left join t as t2 on t1.col1 = t2.col1 where t1.col1 != NULL;
Empty set (0.00 sec)

mysql> select count(*) from t as t1 left join t as t2 on t1.col1 = t2.col1 where t1.col1 != NULL;
+----------+
| count(*) |
+----------+
|        4 |
+----------+
1 row in set (0.00 sec)

mysql> select t1.col1, t2.col2 from t as t1 left join t as t2 on t1.col1 = t2.col1 where t1.col1 != NULL;
+------+------+
| col1 | col2 |
+------+------+
| 2001 | NULL |
| 2001 | NULL |
+------+------+
2 rows in set (0.00 sec)
```

release-4.0 and release-5.0-rc
```
mysql> select *  from t as t1 left join t as t2 on t1.col1 = t2.col1 where t1.col1 != NULL;
+------+------+------+------+
| COL1 | COL2 | COL1 | COL2 |
+------+------+------+------+
| 2001 | 1    | 2001 | 1    |
| 2001 | 1    | 2001 | 2    |
| 2001 | 2    | 2001 | 1    |
| 2001 | 2    | 2001 | 2    |
+------+------+------+------+
4 rows in set (0.00 sec)

mysql> select count(*) from t as t1 left join t as t2 on t1.col1 = t2.col1 where t1.col1 != NULL;
+----------+
| count(*) |
+----------+
|        4 |
+----------+
1 row in set (0.00 sec)

mysql> select t1.col1, t2.col2 from t as t1 left join t as t2 on t1.col1 = t2.col1 where t1.col1 != NULL;
+------+------+
| col1 | col2 |
+------+------+
| 2001 | 1    |
| 2001 | 2    |
| 2001 | 1    |
| 2001 | 2    |
+------+------+
4 rows in set (0.00 sec)
```
### 4. What is your TiDB version? (Required)

<!-- Paste the output of SELECT tidb_version() -->
master dc9ceb4bba96608de2aa5ac906e9ad003fa8a46c
release-5.0-rc f41ca49fab41af6ba168e94e6eeeef517778cee1
release-4.0 8406e7f58b1d5811966a6811d7b519bcfd6020b2
comments:
root cause: In the following plan, filter of "col1 != NULL" is changed to "col1 != 0"
why filter is changed: **(c *compareFunctionClass) refineArgs()**, this function will validate year args. But it accidentally change NULL to int64.

PS: why type of arg1 is year but not NULL: typeInferForNull() change it to year.

    mysql> explain select * from t as t1 left join t as t2 on t1.col1 = t2.col1 where t1.col1 != NULL;
    +------------------------------+---------+-----------+---------------+-------------------------------------------------------+
    | id                           | estRows | task      | access object | operator info                                         |
    +------------------------------+---------+-----------+---------------+-------------------------------------------------------+
    | HashJoin_22                  | 1.66    | root      |               | left outer join, equal:[eq(test.t.col1, test.t.col1)] |
    | ├─TableReader_40(Build)      | 1.33    | root      |               | data:Selection_39                                     |
    | │ └─Selection_39             | 1.33    | cop[tikv] |               | ne(test.t.col1, 0), not(isnull(test.t.col1))          |
    | │   └─TableFullScan_38       | 2.00    | cop[tikv] | table:t2      | keep order:false, stats:pseudo                        |
    | └─TableReader_34(Probe)      | 1.33    | root      |               | data:Selection_33                                     |
    |   └─Selection_33             | 1.33    | cop[tikv] |               | ne(test.t.col1, 0)                                    |
    |     └─TableFullScan_32       | 2.00    | cop[tikv] | table:t1      | keep order:false, stats:pseudo                        |
    +------------------------------+---------+-----------+---------------+-------------------------------------------------------+
